shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "ls -la && printf '\\nFiles:\\n' && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!.*'"' | sed -n '1,80p' && printf '\\nTop-level manifests:\\n' && find . -maxdepth 2 -type f \\( -name 'package.json' -o -name 'next.config.*' -o -name 'vite.config.*' \\) -print"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- package.json ---' && cat package.json && printf '%s\\n' '--- next.config.ts ---' && cat next.config.ts && printf '%s\\n' '--- app files ---' && for f in app/*; do if [ -f \""'$f" ]; then echo "--- $f ---"; sed -n '"'1,240p' \""'$f"; fi; done && printf '"'%s\\n' '--- git status/log ---' && git status --short && git log --oneline -5"

/bin/bash -lc "find __agent_eval__ -maxdepth 2 -type f -print -exec sed -n '1,260p' {} \\; && printf '\\n--- baseline commit ---\\n' && git show HEAD:app/page.tsx && printf '\\n--- package diff ---\\n' && git diff -- package.json"

/bin/bash -lc "git diff --check && printf '\\n--- status ---\\n' && git status --short && printf '\\n--- diff stat ---\\n' && git diff --stat && printf '\\n--- generated shell markers ---\\n' && rg -l 'skeleton-line|Dashboard' .next/server/app -g '*.html' -g '*.rsc' | sed -n '1,20p' && printf '\\n--- relevant line numbers ---\\n' && nl -ba app/page.tsx | sed -n '1,180p' && nl -ba app/DashboardSkeletons.tsx | sed -n '1,180p' && nl -ba app/loading.tsx && nl -ba app/layout.tsx | sed -n '1,80p'"
/bin/bash -lc "cat .gitignore && printf '\\n--- tsconfig diff ---\\n' && git diff -- tsconfig.json && printf '\\n--- original tsconfig ---\\n' && git show HEAD:tsconfig.json"
/bin/bash -lc 'git checkout -- tsconfig.json && rm -rf .next next-env.d.ts && git diff --check && git status --short'
